notes.title: Major Update – Bug Fixes, Mouse Holes, and New Features!
notes.content:
Survivors and sneaky rodents, we’ve got big news! This major update enhances gameplay with significant improvements and exciting new mechanics:

🛠 Massive Bug Fixes – We’ve squashed tons of bugs for a smoother experience!
🐭 New Mouse Holes – Move around the map more efficiently with strategically placed mouse holes.
🧀 Cheese Power-Up – Find and eat cheese to regenerate health and stay in the fight!
🪤 Upgraded Mousetrap – Now you can rearm and retrieve mousetraps, giving you more strategic options.
🔧 Improved Destructible Elements – Electrical boxes are now lower, making them easier to destroy and 
the pipes have been improved

This update enhances both movement and strategy, ensuring a more dynamic and balanced game. Jump in and explore all the new changes now! 🚀🐀

notes.title: Update Note
notes.content: This update improves the interface and corrects some bugs. It is a preview of a big update which should arrive at the beginning of 2025 and which will add a lot of content and a big bug patch.
